title: Clearance to Participate: Packet, Fees and Competition Level — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
Under **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, the athletic or activity coordinator clears a student to participate. A student is never allowed to practice, try out, perform or travel before clearance.

## Clearance conditions

**(a) Packet complete.** A student is cleared only when the participation packet for the school year is complete on the activity records log: every form the type requires, the steroid acknowledgment for a grade the type lists for it, the random drug testing consent where the type includes it, a parent meeting attendance record where the type requires the parent meeting, and, where the type requires a physical examination and the student's grade is one of its physical grades, a pre-participation physical whose exam date is on or after the type's earliest exam date of the calendar year the school year starts.

**(b) Fees settled or first installment paid.** A student is cleared only when every fee posted on the participation is settled (fully offset by credits and payments), or, where the type offers the installment plan and the fees total at least the installment threshold, when the first installment has been paid.

Both conditions are tested on the district's records for this participation: the packet on the participation's activity records log, and the fees, credits and payments on the participation's own ledger.

## Competition level

For High School UIL Athletics, a student whose district enrollment record shows a campus change through an intra-district or non-resident transfer, or a choice program placement, without a bona fide residence move is cleared at the sub-varsity level until the type's transfer varsity wait days after the first day of attendance at the new campus, and at varsity otherwise. Other types are cleared at the not-applicable level.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

| Case | (a) | (b) | Cleared? |
|---|---|---|---|
| All forms on file; fees of 85.00 posted, 85.00 paid | met | met | yes |
| All forms on file; fees of 85.00 posted, 40.00 paid, type offers no plan | met | not met | no |
| All forms on file; installment type, fees total 200.00, first installment paid | met | met | yes |
| Fees settled; one required form missing | not met | met | no |

**Exam date.** For a school year starting in a hypothetical year Y with an earliest exam date of May 1, a physical dated May 1 of year Y counts and one dated April 30 of year Y does not.
